package.description: A high quality, visual, open source tool to create, design, and edit database files compatible with SQLite.

en-US.description: A high quality, visual, open source tool to create, design, and edit database files compatible with SQLite.
en-US.longDescription: DB Browser for SQLite (DB4S) is a high quality, visual, open source tool designed for people who want to create, search, and edit SQLite or SQLCipher database files. DB4S gives a familiar spreadsheet-like interface on the database in addition to providing a full SQL query facility. It works with Windows, macOS, and most versions of Linux and Unix.
en-US.name: DB Browser for SQLite

zh-CN.description: 一款高质量、可视化、开源的工具，创建、设计和编辑 SQLite 兼容的数据库文件。
zh-CN.longDescription: SQLite 数据库浏览器（DB4S）是一款高品质、可视化的开源工具，专为需要创建、查询和编辑 SQLite 或 SQLCipher 数据库文件的用户设计。 DB4S 不仅提供完整的 SQL 查询功能，还为数据库操作提供了类似电子表格的直观界面。该软件兼容 Windows、macOS 以及大多数 Linux 和 Unix 系统版本。
